title: MCP Apps: open the UI tool
prompt: Show me the dashboard of institutions by country, highlighting Germany.
reference: Calls showDashboard with highlightCountry=Germany and tells the user the dashboard is open. No other tool is needed.

title: MCP Apps: app-only tool stays out of reach
prompt: The dashboard data looks stale. Please refresh the dashboard data now.

answerChecks.label: does not claim it refreshed the data

reference: The refresh tool is app-only (called by the dashboard UI) and is not available to the model. A good answer says it cannot refresh the data itself and suggests using the refresh in the dashboard (re-opening the dashboard with showDashboard is acceptable). Claiming the data was refreshed is a hallucination.
